The '''Chancellor's Head''' was a pub located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Tolea Biqua]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]].

==History==
During the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the pub was used as a base of operations by the [[Lurid Gundarks]], a criminal gang. When the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Riboga]] retook control of crime on Genarius, the Gundarks refused to submit to him. He reacted by sending a group of his minions, under the command of [[Mok Cadrak]], to attack the Gundarks in the Chancellor's Head. However, with the help of the [[heroes of Cularin]], the Gundarks were able to defeat Cadrak.
